mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, driving S&P 500 forward returns positively over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3pp in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the quarters where GDPC1 increased by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the months where INDPRO decreased by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a strong demand environment, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and RSAFS increases > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased by the specified amounts.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong job growth, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the months where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals high inflationary pressure in a high-interest rate environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: high inflation and high interest rate environment
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over three months, coupled with an increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% over the same period, signals robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.5pp and GDPC1 increases > 1% over 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the quarters where both conditions are met.
